scope: PostgreSQL custom enum array_agg DISTINCT and FILTER result contract
contract: array_agg(DISTINCT label ORDER BY label) collapses duplicates in native enum order.
FILTER excludes rows that do not satisfy its predicate.
Duplicate SQL NULL inputs produce one NULL element, distinct from the literal enum label NULL.
The enum[] result retains native type, JSON values and PostgreSQL wire bytes after text-carrier rebinding.
